elements.text: ℹ️ Just start chatting with me. I have access to all challenge documentation, curated articles, and code repositories. I cannot search the web.

text.text:
*📊 Daily Usage Limits*

To ensure fair access for everyone, you have a daily quota of questions. Check your usage anytime!

elements.text: 💡 *Usage Tips:* • Type `@nancy my quota` in any channel • Quotas reset at midnight UTC • Use 🍳 Keep Cooking for deeper analysis • Contact admin if you need more queries

text.text:
*🧠 Nancy Brain Web UI*

Power users can use the Nancy Brain Knowledge Base directly for advanced search, graph visualization, and filtering.

*🚀 Quick Commands*

• `/mcp_api_key` - Get your Nancy Brain MCP API key
• `@nancy my quota` - Check your daily usage
• `@nancy help` - Get general assistance
• 🍳 *Keep Cooking* button - Get deeper analysis when I finish a response
• Just ask questions naturally - I'll search my knowledge base automatically!
